verdict.rationale: Published deadlines and late-registration penalties are a fair question for a government registration portal like e-FRRO, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a script-only root page that yields 12 characters of text and a 404 on the long-published entry path. Nothing in the pack documents any filing deadline, penalty, or interest figures.

support.subject: As a founder, the filing deadlines and the penalty and interest schedule for missing them are published with exact figures
